description.subject: A small amigurumi doll worked in yarn, with a white round head and a stitched smile, standing on two feet.
description.covering: A red yarn hooded jacket with cream ruffled edging at the hood, cuffs and hem, fastened with two yellow discs, worn over teal leggings and tan-toned yarn boots with folded cuffs.
description.setting: A plain pale backdrop with the doll standing on a heap of smooth, rounded pebbles and dried beans in cream, tan, chestnut and speckled finishes.
description.light: Even, diffused white light from the front with no hard shadows, neutral to cool in tone.
description.materials: Knitted yarn, plastic bead pupils, flat yellow discs, and polished stone pebbles.
description.anomaly: The doll's face has pink yarn cheek patches and tiny lashes stitched above round bead pupils, set inside a white face framed by a ruffled red hood.
